title: Ashgourd: modeled ₹368/qtl left, Kattappana → Kottakkal
summary: January 2022: reported ashgourd prices at Kattappana and Kottakkal imply a positive modeled margin after costs on 95% of 19 matched days; a morning-report back-test averages ₹368 per quintal. No actual trade verified.
why_selected: Selected from 212 same-variety market pairs screened for ashgourd in January 2022; best tested candidate among the bounded set of routed finalists, not a global optimum.

evidence.observations: daily modal prices for the same variety and grade (FAQ) at both markets; sale matched to the first Kottakkal report 1–3 days after purchase
caveats: Back-test on reported prices: no actual shipment, buyer or seller is claimed.
Modal prices are reported daily aggregates, not offers anyone could be sure to get.
This data has no arrival volumes, so it cannot show whether the destination could absorb more supply; no capital-constrained or volume allocation optimum is claimed.

Costs extrapolate onion survey values (including to other crops) plus stated allowances, not freight quotes; OSRM car routing, not a verified truck route. Representative town points may not be at mandi gates.
Historical: this says what paid then, not what pays today.

scenes.headline: January 2022
scenes.caption: Kattappana (Kerala) and Kottakkal (Kerala) both reported ashgourd prices for the same variety and grade (FAQ) on 19 matched days.

scenes.headline: Two markets, two prices
scenes.caption: Kattappana reported a median ₹1,400 per quintal. Kottakkal reported a median ₹2,100 around modeled arrival days. These are not offers.

scenes.headline: Gap ₹550/qtl
scenes.caption: The median gap was ₹550 per quintal, and Kottakkal was dearer on 100% of days.

scenes.headline: 254 km by road
scenes.caption: 254 km on OpenStreetMap roads (~4 hours by car). A loaded truck is slower, so we allow 1 days plus 7 days to get paid.

scenes.headline: After modeled costs
scenes.caption: Freight ≈₹55/qtl, 5% fees and commission, loading, 5% loss and interest. On the typical day ₹315 per quintal was left.

scenes.headline: Still positive under stress
scenes.caption: With 25% dearer freight, 10% loss and costlier credit, the typical day still kept ₹203 per quintal.

scenes.headline: A trader who only knew the morning's news
scenes.caption: Using only the latest available Kottakkal report, the rule selects 18 of 19 modeled shipping days. 18 had positive modeled net, averaging ₹368 per quintal (₹250 under stress).

scenes.headline: The back-test
scenes.caption: The modeled Ashgourd route from Kattappana to Kottakkal was positive on 95% of matched days in January 2022. At that average, a 100-quintal (10-tonne) load implies ₹36,800, or ₹25,000 under stress. Actual buyer, capacity, haggling, rejection and delays are unknown.

assumptions.value: onion survey freight applied per quintal to ashgourd
scaled by road km against the 1,115 km Lasalgaon→Azadpur route → ₹55/qtl here
12% a year (14% adverse) for transit + 7 days
~450 road km a day → 1 days here

conclusion: The modeled Ashgourd route from Kattappana to Kottakkal was positive on 95% of matched days in January 2022. At that average, a 100-quintal (10-tonne) load implies ₹36,800, or ₹25,000 under stress. Actual buyer, capacity, haggling, rejection and delays are unknown.
